decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera is core to the firm's heritage offer, has its own page, and carries sunk qualification costs, so management persists with it.
The modular multi-model camera line embodies the firm's announced shift toward flexible, compact sensors and represents heavy, publicly visible investment, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The space situational awareness suite extends the firm into a growing field it showcases publicly, and slow uptake can still be blamed on long space procurement cycles.
The newly launched radiation-hard camera line with several models has just been qualified and promoted on its own page, so sunk costs and fresh public commitment favour keeping it.

The asteroid navigation camera is tied to long-running mission commitments and only recently launched, so although it is merely mentioned on the website, management will attribute limited visibility to its mission-specific nature rather than drop it.
